c.h:
This guide aims to help players find the most effective and efficient route of Archaeology training. The bulk of training Archaeology involves working at excavation hotspots at various dig sites found across Gielinor using mattocks. Excavation hotspots yield materials, soil, and, more rarely, damaged artefacts. A blue progress bar will appear above the player's head whilst excavating. Once the progress bar has been filled completely, players will receive a damaged artefact. Excavating remains has a mechanic similar to rockertunities called time sprites. The player gains a boost called Sprite Focus while excavating the highlighted spot, which increases progress towards uncovering a damaged artefact more rapidly than at other spots.

Materials obtained from excavation hotspots are used to restore the damaged artefacts that you find. They can be deposited at materials carts within many dig sites and can be stored and accessed at material storage containers on the surface of each site. If there is no materials cart close to the hotspot you are excavating or you want to be able to AFK for longer then you may want to use signs of the porter to bank materials, though these do not send damaged artefacts to the bank. The grace of the elves can be used to store up to 500 sign of the porter charges (increased to 2,000 with Dark Facet of Grace). Soil acquired during excavations cannot be banked with porters, but can be stored in the archaeological soil box which is obtained after completing the skill tutorial. The soil box initially has capacity to hold 50 of each type of soil, but this can be upgraded significantly as you reach higher qualifications in the skill. Soil can be screened at the station in the Archaeology Campus for additional materials and damaged artefacts. With 70 Archaeology and the associate qualification unlocked the auto-screener v1.080 can be created. This automatically screens gathered soil as it is excavated, though only materials and not damaged artefacts can be gained while using it. Finally the Sift Soil spell, which requires level 91 Magic, can be used to screen soil, but it also produces only materials and not damaged artefacts.

Damaged artefacts can be restored at archaeologist's workbenches, using up materials, for larger amounts of experience. Restored artefacts can be given to particular NPCs for experience and chronotes, a currency used in the Archaeology campus. Handing in all items required to complete a collector's collection of artefacts gives an additional reward. Details of each collection can be found on the collections page.

Occasionally while excavating at any dig site a complete tome can be found. These can be restored at the desk on the of the Archaeology Guild for experience. Having at least tier 2 luck increases the chance of obtaining them. Pieces of the tetracompass can also be found across all excavation hotspots. The restored and powered tetracompass is used like a compass clue to locate a spot where an ancient casket can be uncovered. The casket will always contain 1-2 complete tomes, materials, damaged artefacts and an elite or master clue scrolls, amongst other things.

In addition to this training the skill involves completing mysteries, which are short miniquest-esque activities, and research by sending out a team of archaeologists. You need to reach level 40 Archaeology and complete the assistant qualification to be able to send out research teams. By levelling up and completing mysteries, collections, and research qualifications are gained with the Archaeology Guild. This allows you to unlock benefits such as precision upgrades, the auto-screener v1.080 and increased storage capacity for materials, all of which will be beneficial to the player.

Generally, training Archaeology should be prioritised as follows:

  1. Complete mysteries when you have the required levels for them. Mysteries are required to unlock some of the higher level dig sites and give one-off experience rewards.
  2. Complete collections of artefacts. Prioritise completing each collection for the first time and then excavate the highest level excavation site available to you.
  3. Complete research, prioritising any special research missions as they become available. You will need chronotes, which can be purchased from the Grand Exchange, to send out research missions.
  4. Complete qualifications as you reach the required Archaeology levels and unlock relevant upgrades.

The Archaeology journal can be read to provide information on the player's progress in completing mysteries and special research. It can be right-clicked to use the Information option to check current progress with collectors (if the journal is in the pocket slot the right-click option is Collector information). Information on current amounts of materials in storage can also be viewed through the journal, or by clicking on a damaged artefact.

This guide is divided into sections which are based on the level requirements for each qualification. At the beginning of each section there is an introduction explaining optimal training methods, and variations on these depending on how much Archaeology content that you want to complete.

At these levels you should aim to obtain all of the artefacts needed and complete all the content listed before moving on, even if you have passed the levels required. If you are short of the materials required to restore artefacts purchase them on the Grand Exchange.

Even if you are not looking to complete all Archaeology related content you should follow the recommendations in this section so that you can unlock the assistant qualification. The qualification is required to access the Stormguard Citadel Dig Site, at level 70, and the Warforge Dig Site, at level 76. Additionally it is needed to send out teams to complete research, which is recommended as a passive way to gain additional experience.

1-5

Start out by completing the Archaeology tutorial by speaking to Acting Guildmaster Reiniger at the Archaeology Campus. Upon completion players will have obtained level 5 Archaeology and should progress to the Kharid-et Dig Site.

5-12

Go to the Kharid-et Dig Site, talk with Dr Nabanik, and view the cutscene. Afterwards, walk down the slope, uncover the venator remains, and excavate these. They will give damaged venator light crossbows and damaged venator dagger. To make a start on the artefact collections, you should save two light crossbows and two daggers after restoring them and hand them in to Soran and Velucia to contribute to their collection logs.

12-17

At level 12 speak to Dr Nabanik again to receive a damaged centurion's seal and begin the Breaking the Seal mystery. Excavate the dirt pile blocking the doorway that leads into the rest of Kharid-et dig site. Restore the centurion's seal and click on the excavated door frame to enter Kharid-et - Barracks excavation site.

Head to the first building on the west side, to find the legionary remains and excavate them. To continue with your collection log, you should expect to save two Primis Elementis standards, legionary gladius, and legionary square shields. One damaged gladius can be obtained from the Demon Door research mission once you complete your first Archaeology qualification if you prefer. While you are excavating at the barracks excavation site (recommended for level 12-24 and 25-28) you will randomly receive custodian's log pages. There are a total of four pages to find; once they are discovered you should complete the Prison Break mystery.

This is the first excavation hotspot at the Kharid-et dig site where you can find pylon batteries while excavating. The batteries are used to charge pylons in the main fortress, which gives an amount of Archaeology experience which is dependent on your level and the number of batteries used. When the pylons are fully charged, by players contributing batteries across all game worlds, the Protection of Zaros status effect is activated. This gives +10% Archaeology experience, +5% mattock precision, an increased chance to obtain tetracompass pieces and complete tomes, and a small chance of finding a piece of the inquisitor staff.

17-24

At level 17, move to the castra debris located right in front of the sealed door. Save two restored Zarosian effigies and Zarosian training dummies for Soran and Velucia. Save an additional Zarosian training dummy so that you can unlock Katarina as a researcher for your team once you unlock your research team. Alternatively, a damaged Zarosian training dummy can be obtained from the Proving Grounds research mission if you prefer, once you unlock the team.

24-25

You will unlock the Infernal Source Dig Site at level 20, but you should stay at Kharid-et until you reach level 24. At level 24, go to the Infernal Source Dig Site. Upon using the lift, you will find yourself in the Star Lodge cellar. You will see a furnace missing three crests of Dagon, which must be replaced to complete the Eyes in Their Stars mystery. Three crests of Dagon are needed to complete the mystery. Open all of the Star Lodge storage boxes in the area to find one restored crest of Dagon and one damaged crest of Dagon. You will also find the books 'Doctrinas Cupidate' and 'Philisophia in Cubiculo' which can be read to gain 250 Archaeology experience each and some materials. A third crest of Dagon should be found by excavating the lodge art storage hotspots. You need another four crests of Dagon for collections (making seven all together), and three 'Disorder' paintings.

Once you have acquired the required artefacts from lodge art storage, move to the lodge bar storage hotspots in the southern area. You need three hookah pipes and four opulent wine goblets for collections. An additional restored wine goblet is needed to recruit Dorian to your research team at level 40. One damaged goblet can be obtained from the Starry Eyed research mission if you prefer.

While excavating the lodge art and lodge bar storage you will come across four founder's journal pages; they can only be found at these hotspots. Once you have found them all complete the Eyes in Their Stars mystery using the three crests of Dagon you obtained earlier.

25-29

Head back to the Kharid-et - Barracks excavation site in the main fortress of Kharid-et Dig Site and excavate administratum debris hotspots in the room to the south of the entrance.

This is the last excavation hotspots where custodian's log pages can be obtained so make sure you have obtained all four of them and completed the Prison Break mystery before moving on. You should now have all the artefacts required to fully complete the Museum - Zarosian I and Zarosian I artefact collections for the first time.

29–36

Return to the Infernal Source Dig Site and go to the Dungeon of Disorder area. There are bookshelves here which can be searched to obtain the books 'Amor Dente' and 'Malum Infernale' and a cultist chores rota; each of which can be read to gain 500 Archaeology experience. Excavate the cultist footlocker spots in the south-east corner. Three greater demon masks, three imp masks, and three lesser demon masks are required to complete collections. One damaged imp mask can be obtained from the Abandon All Hope research mission at level 40.

While excavating these spots you will accumulate four cultist's diary journal. Once you have them all complete the Embrace the Chaos mystery. If you walk further forward after completing the Embrace the Chaos mystery you will be greeted by a gargoyle who will prompt the start of the Contract Claws mystery. Contract Claws can be completed at this point.

36-42

At level 36, move to the sacrificial altar pile in the north-west of the Dungeon of Disorder. You will need two Order of Dis robes and three ritual daggers to complete collections. One ritual dagger can be obtained from The Dark Underbelly research mission. You should be able to fully complete the Museum - Zamorakian I and Zamorakian I artefact collections at this point.

With at least level 40 Archaeology the assistant qualification can be unlocked by meeting the achievements listed below and talking to Acting Guildmaster Reiniger (doing so will also complete the Secrets of the Monolith mystery):

If you have completed all the content available up to this point you should meet all the requirements to complete the qualification. If you have not obtained enough materials to restore each artefact that you've discovered at this point, you should purchase materials from Grand Exchange. Avoid material caches unless absolutely necessary.

With this qualification unlocked you can purchase the first set of upgrades from the Archaeology Guild Shop. You should purchase the upgrades to the soil box's capacity, material storage containers' capacity, and base mattock precision. You can also claim two material manuals, two hi-spec monocles, two tarpaulin sheets, and two cups of archaeologist's tea from Acting Guildmaster Reiniger.

You can now also begin sending out teams to complete research. Recruit Katarina and Dorian to your research team by speaking to them around the Varrock Dig Site. You will need to give them the restored Zarosian training dummy and opulent wine goblet which you obtained earlier. You should complete the following special research, which is available at level 40:

After this complete the highest level general research available to you alongside training.

Alongside actively training you should complete the highest level general research available to you as often as you can. This requires spending chronotes, which are tradeable and can be bought from the Grand Exchange.

Even if you are not looking to complete all Archaeology related content you should aim to unlock the associate qualification. This qualification is required to access the Orthen Dig Site at level 90. It is also required to be able to purchase the Archaeologist's outfit and auto-screener v1.080 and to expand the size of your research team.

For the associate qualification you need level 70 Archaeology. Additionally you will need to complete 5 artefact collections and find and restore 250 artefacts. If you have completed all of the content in the level 1-42 section of this guide you will have already completed 4 artefact collections, so you only need to complete one more to meet this requirement if you only wish to complete up to the associate qualification. On the other hand you will only have restored 53 artefacts from level 1-42 and will not restore sufficient artefacts by level 70 to unlock the qualification. You can prioritise meeting this requirement by returning to a low level spot where artefacts can be uncovered and restored quickly, such as venator remains. If you wish to complete collections for a better experience rate you could complete the Zarosian I or Museum - Zarosian I collections, both of which give a 4,271.8 experience completion bonus.

You also need to complete 10 mysteries. If you have completed all of the content in the level 1-42 section of this guide you will have completed 6 mysteries by level 42. There are 7 mysteries in the level 42-70 section of this guide which players are recommended to complete in this level range (other mysteries may be completed depending on your luck with obtaining required items, but the named mysteries include those where the highest level hotspot where any required item can be obtained is within this level range). You can complete any 4 additional mysteries to meet this requirement. Time Served, Fallen Angels, and Dagon Bye can be easily completed without having to obtain special drops. Finally, you must complete 24 hours worth of research by sending out your team.

42-45

At level 42 head to the Everlight Dig Site and go through the cutscene. Excavate the prodromoi remains; you will need two 'frying pans' and two hallowed lanterns to complete collections, as well as an additional 'frying pan' and two hallowed lanterns to complete mysteries. One damaged hallowed lantern can be obtained from the Lions and Unicorns and Centaurs, Oh My! special research mission at level 42 Archaeology. While excavating here (or later at monoceros remains from level 48-50) you will accumulate four queen's journal pages and may find icyene remains. Once you have all the journal pages you can complete the Queen of the Icyene mystery. When the icyene remains are found the Fallen Angels mystery can be completed. With level 40 Construction and 10 white marble (unnoted) the Statue of Hebe can be repaired. A restored hallowed lantern can then be added to the statue to gain 785 Archaeology experience and some materials.

45-47

Return to the Dungeon of Disorder section of the Infernal Source Dig Site and excavate the dis dungeon debris hotspot. This is the last hotspot where the cultist's diary pages can be obtained, so find all of these and complete the Embrace the Chaos mystery before moving on.

47-48

Go to the Kharid-et Dig Site and enter the Kharid-et - Carcerem excavation site (the prison). You will need to complete the Prison Break mystery to enter this area if you have not already done so. A restored legatus pendant can be added to the tool belt to allow access to more areas in the carcerem excavation site which are otherwise blocked by the legatus barrier.

48-51

Return to the Everlight - Mass grave excavation site at Everlight Dig Site. Excavate the monoceros remains. If you have not already collected the four queen's journal pages and icyene remains, find these and complete Queen of the Icyene and Fallen Angels mysteries before moving on. With your fourth Ceremonial unicorn ornament, you can now go find Eduardo (student) in the Varrock Dig Site and have him join your team.

51–52

At level 51 switch to the amphitheatre debris excavation hotspots at the Everlight - Amphitheatre excavation site. With level 40 Construction and 10 white marble (unnoted) the Statue of Mesomedes can be repaired. A restored everlight harp can then be added to the statue to gain 1,278 Archaeology experience and a hand of glory.

52—56

Visit the Moonrise - Temple periphery excavation site to excavate the Lunar wheel debris excavation site. You must complete the Secrets of Amberfell quest to start excavating at the Moonrise Dig Site.

56–58

At level 56 switch to the ceramics studio debris excavation hotpots at the Everlight - Amphitheatre excavation site. You should now be able to fully complete the Museum - Saradominist I and Saradominist I artefact collections for the first time.

58-59

Return to the Kharid-et - Carcerem excavation site and pass through the legatus barrier to excavate the carcerem debris. One more 'Incite Fear' spell scroll is required to complete The Vault of Shadows quest. An additional restored pontifex signet ring should be added to the tool belt to allow the player to pass through the pontifex barrier to access further excavation hotspots. You may also wish to create a pontifex observation ring, which uses another pontifex signet ring.

59—60

Return to the Moonrise - Temple periphery excavation site to excavate the Arbour rubble.

60—61

At level 60 you can access the Senntisten Dig Site and excavate the ministry remains at the Senntisten - Cathedral excavation site. You can obtain the first Inquisitor's Memoirs page from this hotspot; this is required for the Secrets of the Inquisition mystery, a restored funerary urn of shadow is also needed.

Ancient glass shards are found while excavating throughout the Senntisten Dig Site. These can be used to repair the four broken stained glass windows in the cathedral. To fully repair each window 100 ancient glass shards and level 80 Crafting are required. Repairing all the windows completes the Pane in the Glass achievement.

61-62

Return to the Everlight - Dominion Games stadium excavation site and excavate stadio debris. While excavating here you will be able to find five athlete's journal pages and complete the Fall and Rise mystery. These can also be found later while excavating at other hotspots in the Dominion Games stadium excavation site at level 69 and 100.

62-63

Go to the Senntisten - Cathedral excavation site and excavate the cathedral debris. You can obtain the second Inquisitor's Memoirs page from this hotspot; this is required for the Secrets of the Inquisition mystery, a restored funerary urn of smoke is also needed. Pages one and two of A critic's review can only be obtained from cathedral debris; these are needed later to complete the Night Theatre mystery. You should now be able to complete the Museum - Zarosian V collection for the first time.

63-64

Move to the Senntisten - Marketplace excavation site at level 63 and collect from the marketplace debris. A restored funerary urn of ice is also needed. A critic's review (article 4) (for the Night Theatre mystery) and a warning letter (for the Empty Children mystery) can only be obtained from the marketplace debris. You should also complete the Complete the Pattern, Solve the Puzzle special research.

64-65

At level 64 move to the inquisitor remains in the marketplace excavation site. A critic's review (article 3) and pages three and four of the Inquisitor's Memoirs can only be uncovered at this excavation hotspot. You can complete the Finery of the Inquisition collection at this point. You should now be able to complete the Museum - Zarosian VI collection for the first time.

65-66

At level 65 go to the Infernal Source - Vestibule of Futility south excavation site and excavate at Infernal art.

66-67

Return to the Senntisten - Marketplace excavation site and begin excavating the gladiator remains. At the colosseum gateway use the "enter (non combat)" option. While here you can obtain the fourth page of the Inquisitor's Memoirs and progress the Secrets of the Inquisition mystery using a restored funerary urn of blood, along with the three other funerary urns from previous excavation hotspots. It is recommended to complete up until the point where the Crossing that Bridge special research is sent out as soon as you can, as this is required to unlock the next excavation site. Additionally a scrawled note (for the Empty Children mystery) can only be obtained from this hotspot. After this has been obtained the mystery can be completed.

Return to the Moonrise - Temple periphery excavation site to excavate the Weaver's hut debris. You should now be able to fully complete the Guthixian I and Museum - Guthixian I artefact collections.

67-68

Once you have reached level 67 and have completed the Crossing that Bridge research you can move to the Senntisten - Bridge excavation site. Excavate the citizen remains there. Pages six and seven of the Inquisitor's Memoirs can only be obtained at this site. The eighth page can only be obtained from the ministry remains hotspot after these have been obtained, so you will have to backtrack at this point to find it. You can then complete the Secrets of the Inquisition mystery. The fifth critic's review article can also only be obtained here, after finding it the Night Theatre mystery can be completed. There are four artefact collections which can be completed after this excavation hotspot: Museum - Zarosian VII, Entertaining the Masses, Religious Iconography, and Urns of the Empire.

68-69

At level 68 go to the Infernal Source - Vestibule of Futility north-east excavation site at the Infernal Source Dig Site. Excavate the shakroth remains. Before handing in the spiked collars you may want to complete the Who's a Bad Boy? achievement; the collar is not consumed while doing so. An additional restored chaos star can be added to your tool belt to prevent portals in the area from misfiring. You can then complete the Dagon Bye mystery, as it requires having a chaos star but one stored in the tool belt will work. After completing this mystery you should have completed all the Infernal Source site mysteries and will be able to recruit Movario to your research team.

69—70

Return to the Dominion Games stadium excavation site and excavate the dominion games podium hotspots. Obtain three bronze dominion medals, three dominion torchs, and three silver dominion medals for collections. One dominion torch can be obtained by completing the Stadio Ga Ga special research mission. Restore the statue of Padosan with level 40 Construction and 10 white marble. Add a restored dominion torch to gain 2,470 Archaeology experience. Another dominion torch is required to complete the Hallowed Be... mystery later on. If you have not already, obtain all of the five athlete's journal pages and complete the Fall and Rise mystery. The Blingy Fings artefact collection can be fully completed for the first time at this point.

With at least level 70 Archaeology the associate qualification can be unlocked by meeting the achievements listed below and talking to Acting Guildmaster Reiniger:

However, you are not likely to have found and restored enough artefacts at this point to be able to complete the qualification straight away. You can either opt to continue training and unlock the qualification once you hit the required number of artefacts or return to a low level spot where artefacts can be uncovered and restored quickly. Venator remains work well for this. If you wish to complete collections for a better experience rate you could complete the Zarosian I or Museum - Zarosian I collections, both of which give a 4,271.8 experience completion bonus.

With the associate qualification unlocked you can purchase the next set of upgrades from the Archaeology Guild Shop. You should purchase the upgrades to the soil box's capacity, material storage containers' capacity, and base mattock precision. You can also purchase the archaeologist's outfit, which gives a boost of 1% increased experience gain per piece worn, with a bonus 1% when the full set is worn, up to a 6% boost. You may wish to purchase the blueprints for the auto-screener v1.080, which requires level 67 Invention to manufacture. With the auto-screener soil is automatically converted into materials available at the excavation hotspot that the player is using. The auto-screener does not yield any damaged artefacts or yield any Archaeology or Invention experience when converting soil.

After completing the qualification three material manuals, three hi-spec monocles, three tarpaulin sheets, and three cups of archaeologist's tea may be claimed from Acting Guildmaster Reiniger by talking to her.

You can now also recruit Alpheus and Eliza to your research team. They are located on Anachronia and will ask to join your team if you show them a completed totem. You can complete the Mysterious Monolith: Architecture special research.

You may or may not wish to eventually unlock the professor qualification, at level 90, and the guildmaster qualification, at level 99 depending on your training goals. Both of these qualifications expand the size of your research team and allow further upgrades to soil box and material storage capacity and mattock precision to be purchased in the Archaeology Guild Shop. The guildmaster qualification allows the master archaeologist's outfit and an energised meteorite shard, required to create the mattock of time and space, to be purchased from the guild. If you are aiming to train to level 120 or beyond it would be recommended to obtain all qualifications. To work towards unlocking all qualifications you should aim to obtain all of the artefacts needed in the level 70-90 section and complete the artefact collections and mysteries listed to progress towards the total number of unique collections and mystery completions required.

If you were aiming to reach the associate qualification only, you can now move to completing artefact collections for fast experience rates. Continue completing the Zarosian I or Museum - Zarosian I collections until level 76. At level 76 you can enter the Warforge Dig Site and excavate the gladiatorial goblin remains. At level 83 you should complete the Out of the Crucible mystery so that you can also excavate the goblin dorm debris. With both of these sites available you can repeatedly complete the Green Gobbo Goodies I artefact collection for 34,533.5 experience per completion. A piece of a tetracompass is rewarded each time that the collection is handed in. Restore tetracompasses and solve them to obtain at least 1-2 complete tomes per tetracompass. A completed tome gives at least 22,857.6 experience, at level 83 Archaeology.

At level 89 you can start to excavate the Big High War God shrine excavation hotspots to work towards completing Green Gobbo Goodies II collections. All three of the artefacts from this spot are required, plus an idithuun horn ring from the yu'biusk animal pen hotspot, at level 94, and a garagorshuun anchor from the goblin trainee remains hotspot, at level 97. With all of these sites available you can repeatedly complete the Green Gobbo Goodies II artefact collection for 60,666.6 experience per completion. A completed tome gives at least 41,290 experience, at level 97 Archaeology. If you find all four pieces of imcando metal while at the Warforge dig site you may wish to complete the Into the Forge mystery so that you can smith an imcando mattock.

70-72

At level 70 you will be invited to go to the Stormguard Citadel Dig Site. Head to the Temple of Ikov and study the northern or southern archway to uncover the Ikovian Tragedy special research. Send off your research team and start excavating the Ikovian memorial hotspots. Once you have obtained and restored an Ikovian gerege, either from the hotspots or from completing the special research, add it to your tool belt.

Enter the citadel and continue excavating the Ikovian memorials. While excavating the Ikovian memorial hotspots inside the citadel there is a chance that you will find the boots of flight. When you find them you can add them to your tool belt and complete the Leap of Faith mystery. The exile's vow can only be found while excavating Ikovian memorial hotspots. When this is found talk to Gee'ka to complete the Atonement mystery.

While excavating at hotspots within the Stormguard Citadel you can find torn blueprint fragments which are used to create blueprints for Ancient Invention; however this cannot be unlocked until you reach level 95 Archaeology.

72-73

Return to the Everlight - Oikoi excavation site and excavate the oikos studio debris piles. You may find a psiloi buckler while excavating here, this and a restored kantharos cup should be kept to complete The Everlight mystery later on. The four pages of Archon's journal may be found here, or at level 84 at the oikos fishing hut remnants. If you get them all complete The Dour of Bable mystery.

You can now complete the Museum - Saradominist II and Saradominist II collections for the first time.

73-74

At level 73 you will be able to use the Daemonheim Dig Site for the first time. To use the dig site you will need to have freed Skaldrun while completing frozen floors while dungeoneering. Head to the Daemonheim - Castle excavation site and excavate the castle hall rubble. Obtain Balarak's and Tokshak's rings, which can only be obtained at the castle hall rubble hotspots, required for completing the A New Home mystery later.

74-75

Excavate the Kharid-et chapel debris. You may start to find the three pages of the pater's log here. They may also be found at later excavation hotspots. When you have found them all complete The Cult of Orcus mystery.

75—76

Return to the Moonrise - Temple periphery excavation site to excavate the Shrine Debris.

76—77

First return to the Stormguard Citadel Dig Site. If you have not already obtained the Boots of Flight from the Ikovian memorial hotspot excavate this now as they become a guaranteed drop at level 76 Archaeology. When you have the boots find the damaged wingsuit v1, restore it, and add it to your tool belt. Find two lightning conductors to upgrade to the wingsuit v2 and then two gravitron repulsors to upgrade to the wingsuit v3. Complete the Wing Out mystery once you have fully upgraded the wingsuit. Excavate the keshik ger hotspots at the Stormguard Citadel - Keshik memorial excavation site. You may start to find the three mission reports required to complete The Spy Who Loved Metal mystery, though these can also be found later on. Once you have completed Wing Out and have restored the required artefacts, swap to the Warforge Dig Site.

Maximising time at the Warforge site over the Stormguard Citadel is recommended as you will obtain the pieces required to forge the imcando mattock here. Talk to Zanik at the Warforge to view the introductory cutscene. Excavate the gladiatorial goblin remains at the Warforge - Crucible arena excavation site. You may start to find some of the five pages for The First Commander mystery, though these can also be found at later excavation hotspots.

77—78

Return to the Daemonheim - Castle excavation site and excavate the tunnelling equipment repository. Find Halak's ring for the A New Home mystery; it can only be found at this hotspot. You can now complete Dragonkin V and Museum - Dragonkin V for the first time.

78—81

At level 78 move to the botanical reserves on the of the Daemonheim dig site. Find Yorga's pipe for the A New Home mystery; it can only be found at this site. If you have not already found all four pieces for the imcando mattock then return to the gladiatorial goblin remains after finding the pipe and the artefacts needed from the botanical reserves.

81—82

There are four different excavation hotspots available at level 81 Archaeology, so you will hop between them until you have the required artefacts from each.

At the Infernal Source - Vestibule of Futility south-east excavation site excavate the animal trophies. Complete the Zamorakian II and Museum - Zamorakian II collections by handing in artefacts to Isaura and Velucia.

At the Stormguard Citadel - Relay station excavation site excavate the tailory debris. If you have not already completed The Spy Who Loved Metal, obtain the three required mission reports from this hotspot and complete the mystery as this is the last hotspot where the reports will be obtained. An aviansie dreamcoat can be given to Armadyl at the top of his tower to obtain the ring of Solomon, which is used to unlock the Death Ward relic power. Hand in artefacts to Lowse and Velcuia to complete the Armadylean I and Museum - Armadylean I collections for the first time.

At the Kharid-et - Chapel excavation site excavate the pontifex remains. Complete the Zarosian II, Museum - Zarosian II, and Smoky Fings collections for the first time by handing in the required artefacts.

Finally, return to the Warforge Dig Site and excavate crucible stands debris. Continue at this excavation hotspot until you reach level 83 to maximise your chances of finding all pieces of the imcando mattock.

82—83

At level 82, visit the Moonrise - Temple depths excavation site to excavate the Cauldron debris.

83-84

At level 83 excavate the barricade in the Warforge Dig Site; fully removing it completes the Out of the Crucible mystery and allows access to the Warforge - South goblin tunnels excavation site. Enter the area and investigate the doors to Thalmund's Forge to begin the Into the Forge mystery. Complete the mystery by finding 11 keys throughout the area; this requires 35 Dungeoneering and 28 Fishing. After completing the mystery you can access the forge and create an imcando mattock once you have found all four imcando metal pieces.

Excavate the goblin dorm debris. You can complete your first Green Gobbo Goodies I collection by handing in artefacts to General Wartface.

84-85

Go to the Everlight - Oikoi excavation site and excavate the Oikos fishing hut remnants. If you have not already completed The Dour of Bable mystery make sure you have obtained the four pages of Archon's journal and complete it now, as this is the last excavation hotspot that they can be obtained from.

85-86

At the Stormguard Citadel - Research & Development north-west excavation site excavate the weapons research debris. Restore two hawkeye lens multi-vision scopes and two talon-3 razor wings for collections. You may start to find project pages required for the A Study in Aether mystery here, and at later hotspots. If you have level 70 Divination (and level 91 Archaeology if excavating the required quintessence), you may wish to activate the nearby stormguard portal, using 20 unnoted quintessence, for easy access to the excavation hotspot.

86-87

Go to the Kharid-et - Chapel excavation site and excavate the orcus altars. Obtain an additional restored spell scroll if you want to complete The Vault of Shadows, as one is consumed during the quest. A restored necromantic focus is also required for the Tomes of the Warlock quest. This is the final hotspot where the three pater's log pages can be found, so obtain these and complete The Cult of Orcus mystery if you have not already done so.

87—88

Return to the Daemonheim - Castle excavation site and excavate the communal space spots on the . Add a restored 'friendship bracelet' to your tool belt to allow access to the Daemonheim - Depths excavation site. Find the tarnished plaque, which can only be found at the communal space hotspots, and complete the A New Home mystery. You can complete the Dragonkin VI and Museum - Dragonkin VI collections after this site. Hand in the artefacts to Sharrigan and Velucia.

88—89

At level 88, return to the Moonrise - Temple depths excavation site to excavate the Blood Altar (excavation hotspot). You may now complete Guthixian II.

89—90

Excavate dis overspill at the Infernal Source - The Harrowing south-east excavation site.

Once you have the required artefacts from the Infernal Source, go to the Warforge - North goblin tunnels and excavate from the Big High War God shrine hotspots. You may find the Forge War! page here and hand it in to complete the Forge War! mystery, but this can also be completed at later hotspots. The Museum - Bandosian I, Hitty Fings, and Anarchic Abstraction collections can be completed at this point.

With at least level 90 Archaeology the professor qualification can be unlocked by meeting the achievements listed below and talking to Acting Guildmaster Reiniger:

If you have completed all the artefact collections and mysteries up until this point you will have completed a total of 32/20 unique artefact collections and 22/15 mysteries required for the qualification. However, you are not likely to have found and restored enough artefacts at this point to be able to complete the qualification straight away. You can either opt to continue training and unlock the qualification once you hit the required number of artefacts or return to complete quick collections of artefacts to meet the requirement. Completion of Green Gobbo Goodies I or Green Gobbo Goodies II is recommended if you wish to do this. For more information see here.

When you have unlocked the professor qualification you can complete the Mysterious Monolith: Symbology special research and automatically unlock Drew, Helen, and Easty for your research team. You can now purchase another set of upgrades from the Archaeology Guild Shop: to the soil box's capacity, material storage containers' capacity, and base mattock precision. You can also purchase an additional relic loadout slot if you wish. Four material manuals, four hi-spec monocles, four tarpaulin sheets, and four cups of archaeologist's tea may be claimed from Acting Guildmaster Reiniger by talking to her after completing the qualification.

If you have completed all of the artefact collections and mysteries up to the end of the level 70-90 section of this guide you will already have met the requirements for unique artefact collections and mystery completions required for the guildmaster qualification, so completing further mysteries and collections is optional. For fast experience (only if you are level 97) excavate Big High War God shrine excavation hotspots and repeatedly complete the Green Gobbo Goodies II collection. All three of the artefacts from this spot are required, plus an idithuun horn ring from the yu'biusk animal pen hotspot, at level 94, and a garagorshuun anchor from the goblin trainee remains hotspot, at level 97. With all of these sites available you can repeatedly complete the Green Gobbo Goodies II artefact collection for 60,666.6 experience and a tetracompass piece per completion. A completed tome obtained from a full tetracompass gives at least 41,290 experience, at level 97 Archaeology. If you find all four pieces of imcando metal while at the Warforge dig site you may wish to complete the Into the Forge mystery so that you can smith an imcando mattock.

90-91

You can now access the Orthen Dig Site on Anachronia for the first time. Upon arriving speak to Mr Mordaut to view a cutscene; activate the inactive teleport device east of the base camp lodestone; and then head to the Orthen - Crypt of Varanus excavation site. Activate the Orthen teleportation device outside the crypt, which unlocks the Incomplete Portal Network I special research and progresses the Teleport Node On mystery, then enter the site and excavate the varanusaur remains. Study the funeral pyre in the centre of the room to unlock the Breath of Fire special research mission. While excavating here you may find the four pages required to complete Crypt o' Zoology; though these can also be found at later hotspots. While excavating at this hotspot or the dragonkin reliquary excavation hotspots at level 96, you may find four fragments of the Archaeology potion recipe. With level 90 Archaeology to the Know Thy Measure mystery can be completed.

The Orthen Dig Site has a mechanic similar to the pylon at the Al-Kharid dig site. While excavating here you can find rex skeleton fragments which can be used to restore the rex skeleton at Anachronia base camp. When the skeleton has been fully completed by players across all game worlds the Roar of Osseous buff is activated. This gives 25% increased experience and a 10% increased chance to receive materials while training Archaeology on Anachronia for 65 minutes.

With level 90 Archaeology and completion of Desperate Measures you can excavate at the Orthen - Nodon hibernatorium excavation site's orthen rubble hotspot. Excavate the orthen rubble and dragonkin remains until you have found the ceremonial dragonkin device and ceremonial dragonkin tablet. Each of these can only be obtained once. Restore them and hand them in to Giles to complete the Desperate for Artefacts collection, which awards a cosmic pyramid. The pyramid can be combined with the cosmic focus to create the cosmic accumulator. The cosmic accumulator prevents sprite focus from dropping below 20% while excavating and can provide a buff to sprite focus gain while excavating a hotspot with a time sprite active on it.

91-92

At level 91 move back to the Stormguard Citadel - Research & Development north-west excavation site. Excavate the gravitron research debris. Complete the Wise Am the Music Man collection by handing in artefacts to the Wise Old Man.

Using either an imcando or elder rune mattock with all available mattock upgrades and wearing the full archaeologist's outfit, experience rates average around 117,000 experience an hour at these spots.

92-93

Return to the Everlight - Acropolis excavation site and excavate the acropolis debris. You can now complete the Showy Fings collection with Chief Tess for the first time. One restored rod can be added to the statue of Tromple once it has been restored using 10 white marble with level 40 Construction. The completed statue can be opened to receive the 'Tromple's Troubling Tales' experience book, which grants 50,000 Archaeology experience when it is read. This should also complete the No Secrets Left to Steal achievement. At this site you may start to find the five excerpts of the Epic of Hebe, which are required to complete The Epic of Hebe mystery. They can also be found later on at the level 109 excavation site.

93-94

Go to the Kharid-et - Culinarum excavation site and get two Zarosian ewers and Zarosian steins from the armarium debris. Using either an imcando or elder rune mattock with all available mattock upgrades and wearing the full archaeologist's outfit, experience rates average around 120,000-130,000 experience an hour at these spots, plus any additional experience from handing in pylon batteries.

94-95

Excavate the Yu'biusk animal pen hotspots at the Warforge - Animal pens excavation site. You can hand in the Red Rum Relics I collection to General Bentnoze for the first time. Using either an imcando or elder rune mattock with all available mattock upgrades and wearing the full archaeologist's outfit, experience rates average around 125,000 experience an hour at these spots.

95-96

Return to the Stormguard Citadel - Dayguard tower excavation site and excavate Keshik tower debris. Once you have restored one stormguard gerege you can add it to your tool belt and complete the Howl's Floating Workshop mystery and the Back to the Drawing Board special research. This unlocks access to Ancient Invention and the ability to create blueprints using any torn blueprint fragments that you have collected up until this point.

This excavation site is very remote. Use of signs of the porter or magic notepaper is recommended. Using either an imcando or elder rune mattock with all available mattock upgrades and wearing the full archaeologist's outfit, experience rates average around 143,000-150,000 experience an hour at these spots.

96-97

Return to the Orthen - Crypt of Varanus excavation site and train at the dragonkin reliquary excavation hotspots. You may find more pages for the Crypt o' Zoology mystery here, though these can also be obtained later on. You can also obtain fragments for the Archaeology potion recipe here.

97-98

Go back to the Warforge - North goblin tunnels and excavate the goblin trainee remains. One of the Ourg megahitters is required to recruit Asgarnia Smith to your research team later on. You can complete the Green Gobbo Goodies II collection with General Wartface for the first time.

Using either an imcando or elder rune mattock with all available mattock upgrades and wearing the full archaeologist's outfit, experience rates average around 152,000 experience an hour at these spots.

98-99

Go to the Infernal Source - The Harrowing north-west excavation site and excavate Byzroth remains.

After you have obtained all the required artefacts from the Infernal Source switch to the Stormguard Citadel - Research & Development south-west excavation site. Excavate the destroyed golem excavation hotspots. One restored set of golem instructions is required to recruit Elissa Giovanni to your research team later on. Complete the Museum - Armadylean II and Armadylean II artefact collections by handing them in to Velucia and Lowse.

Using either an imcando or elder rune mattock with all available mattock upgrades and wearing the full archaeologist's outfit, experience rates average around 172,000 experience an hour at these spots.

With at least level 99 Archaeology the guildmaster qualification can be unlocked by meeting the achievements listed below and talking to Acting Guildmaster Reiniger:

However, you are not likely to have found and restored enough artefacts at this point to be able to complete the qualification straight away. You can either opt to continue training and unlock the qualification once you hit the required number of artefacts or return to complete quick collections of artefacts to meet the requirement. Completion of Green Gobbo Goodies II is recommended if you wish to do this.

When you have unlocked the guildmaster qualification you can complete the Philosophy and the Writings of the Walls: Kharid-et, Infernal Source, Everlight, Stormguard, and Warforge special research. Completing these will complete the Writings on the Walls mystery. Simon Templeton is automatically unlocked for your research team and Anna Jones, Asgarnia Smith, and Elissa Giovanni can be recruited (a restored ourg megahitter and golem instructions are required for Asgarnia and Elissa).

You can now purchase the final base mattock precision upgrade from the Archaeology Guild Shop, as well as the master archaeologist's outfit, and the energised meteorite shard which is used to create the mattock of Time and Space. Five material manuals, five hi-spec monocles, five tarpaulin sheets, and five cups of archaeologist's tea may be claimed from Acting Guildmaster Reiniger by talking to her after completing the qualification.

If you are looking for the fastest experience rates you can continue to repeatedly complete the Green Gobbo Goodies II collection for 60,666.6 experience per completion.

At level 100 you can switch to completing the Saradominist III collection. This requires both artefacts from each of the Oikos fishing hut remnants, acropolis debris, and icyene weapon rack excavation hotspots. Handing in a complete collection gives 77,778 experience and a tetracompass piece. The completed tome obtained from each tetracompass assembled gives at least 46,704 experience, at level 100 Archaeology.

From level 102 the Dragonkin II collection can be completed. The collection includes only four artefacts, which are obtained from the autopsy table and experiment workbench excavation hotspots. Each completion of the collection awards 81,666.6 experience and 75 rex skeleton fragments. Assuming that the fragments are used to restore the rex skeleton in sets of 100, this equals an additional 42,921 experience per completion. Repeating this collection is an effective strategy up to level 110 or so.

From level 115-119 you may wish to remain at the Bandos's sanctum debris hotspots and collect the three different kinds of artefact from the spot. At level 119 you can then switch to makeshift pie ovens and obtain 'Da Boss Man' sculptures to complete the Red Rum Relics III collection. The collection gives 159,999.9 experience and a tetracompass piece for each completion. The completed tome obtained from each tetracompass assembled gives at least 80,261 experience, at level 119 Archaeology.

99-100

Go to the Orthen - Crypt of Varanus excavation site and excavate the dragonkin coffins. You should now have all the artefacts required to complete the Museum - Dragonkin I and Dragonkin I artefact collections. Hand them in to Velucia and Sharrigan. If you have not already completed Crypt o' Zoology mystery then obtain all four of the required pages before moving on, as this is the last spot where they can be obtained. You may also find fragments of the Summoning renewal recipe while training here.

100-101

At level 100 return to the Warforge and study Bandos's throne to unlock the Power Behind the Throne special research. Complete the research and excavate the kyzaj champion's boudoir hotspots in the Warforge - South goblin tunnels excavation site. Complete the You Have Chosen... mystery using one restored spear and one restored sculpture. You can also complete the Stick It to Da Boss Man achievement using a restored dorgeshuun spear; the spear is not consumed while completing the achievement. The Museum - Bandosian II collection can be completed for the first time by speaking to Velucia.

After you have completed everything at the Warforge head to the Everlight - Dominion Games stadium excavation site and excavate from the icyene weapon racks. Complete the Museum - Saradominist III and Saradominist III collections for the first times by speaking to Velucia and Sir Atcha.

Finally, go to the Kharid-et - Culinarum excavation site's culinarum debris hotspots. One restored spell scroll should be saved to complete the Vault of Shadows quest.

Using a mattock of Time and Space with all available mattock upgrades and wearing the full master archaeologist's outfit experience rates average around 183,000 experience an hour at these spots. Additional experience is gained at the Kharid-et site from obtaining and handing in pylon batteries.

101-102

Head to the Orthen - Observation outpost excavation site and excavate the autopsy tables. If you have not already, complete the Incomplete Portal Network I special research and repair the orthen teleportation device at the outpost. This requires level 70 Runecrafting and 20 un-noted ancient vis. These hotspots may give pieces of the Summoning renewal recipe.

102-103

At level 102 move to the experiment workbenches. The workbench hotspots may drop fragments of the holy aggroverload recipe. Before moving on complete the Death Watch mystery by finding the four pages from the two types of site in the outpost excavation site. You can also complete the Dragonkin II and Museum - Dragonkin II collections for the first time by handing in artefacts to Sharrigan and Velucia.

103-104

Return to the Stormguard Citadel - Nightguard tower excavation site and excavate the keshik weapon racks.

After the required artefacts from the keshik weapon racks have been obtained and restored, players with level 95 Dungeoneering can go to the Daemonheim - Castle excavation site. Unlock and complete the On the Threshold of the Mind special research mission. You can then enter the imposing door to the Daemonheim - Depths excavation site. Excavate the projection spaces.

104-105

At the Warforge - North goblin tunnels site excavate from the Warforge scrap piles.

Go to the Infernal Source - The Harrowing north-east excavation site site and excavate the hellfire forges excavation hotspots. Complete the Zamorakian III and Museum - Zamorakian III collections for the first time. This site is recommended over the Warforge scrap piles as the artefacts obtained there require materials only obtainable from other digsites. Experience rates at this level are around 210,000 experience an hour, with bonuses.

105-106

Excavate the stockpiled art hotspots at the Everlight - Underwater cave excavation site. If you have not already done so you will need to progress the Hallowed Be... mystery up until the point where you access the underwater cave to the excavation site. While excavating here you will commonly obtain mosaic pieces. When you have 300 you can complete the Hallowed Be... mystery. A restored 'Hallowed Be the Everlight' painting is also required during the mystery, but it is not consumed. You can complete the Radiant Renaissance artefact collection for the first time. With level 105 Archaeology you can create a lit hallowed lantern and use it on the repaired Statue of Hebe to gain 'The Epic of Hebe' reward book. This can be read to receive 50,000 Archaeology experience.

106-107

At level 106 you should complete the Incomplete Portal Network II special research, if you have not already done so, and complete the Know Thy Measure mystery to unlock access to the Moksha ritual site. Repair the Orthen teleportation device outside the ritual site using 20 un-noted orthenglass. Enter the Orthen - Moksha ritual site excavation site and excavate the aughra remains. While excavating here you may find the four pages required to complete the Free Your Mind mystery.

107-108

First, return to the Daemonheim - Depths excavation site and excavate the security booths. You should get the chunk of primal alloy before moving on, as it can only be obtained at this excavation hotspot and is required to complete A New Form. You may uncover a strange token while excavating here. If you do, the mystery A New Age can be completed.

Next move to the Kharid-et - Praetorium excavation site and excavate ancient magick munitions hotspots. One of the spell scrolls is required for The Vault of Shadows quest and mystery. You can start to find the six pages from the commander's log, for the Decimation mystery, and the five pages from the Praetorian's log, for the Shadow Fall mystery at this hotspot. You will also have all the restored artefacts required to complete the Museum - Zarosian III, Zarosian III, and Imperial Sorcery collections for the first time.

108-109

Return to the Orthen - Moksha ritual site excavation site and excavate moksha devices. Complete the Fragmented Memories mystery using a restored lingam stone and master control to gain access to Xolo City. You can also complete the Dragonkin III and Museum - Dragonkin III artefact collections for the first time.

109-110

Go to the bibliotheke debris at the Everlight - Acropolis excavation site.

110-111

First go to the Infernal Source - Dagon Overlook north excavation site and excavate the chthonian trophies.

For the rest of the level go to the Warforge weapon racks at the Warforge - Thalmund's forge excavation site. Complete the Red Rum Relics II collection for the first time by handing in artefacts to General Bentnoze. You may find the five pages required to complete the Heart of the Forge mystery at this spot.

111-112

Go to the Stormguard Citadel - Research & Development south-east excavation site. Excavate from the flight research debris.

112-113

At level 112 move to the Stormguard Citadel - Howl's workshop excavation site and excavate from the aetherium forges. A damaged prototype godsword is used in the That's Not How it Works achievement, but is not consumed.

113-114

At the level 113 you will start training at the Orthen - Xolo city excavation site for the first time. You will need to complete the Fragmented Memories mystery to enter the site if you have not done so previously. Complete the Incomplete Portal Network III special research and restore the Orthen teleportation device outside Xolo City using 20 un-noted quintessence. You should now have restored all the teleportation devices, which completes the Teleport Node On mystery.

At Xolo City excavate from the xolo mines. You can start to find the four pages required to complete the I Am Become Death mystery at this site, as well as fragments of the powerburst of opportunity recipe.

After this complete the Thought Process special research to unlock the Daemonheim - Depths excavation site. Train at the traveller's stations. Complete the Dragonkin VII and Museum - Dragonkin VII artefact collections. The cracked totem and mangled trinket required to complete A New Form mystery can only be excavated from this hotspot, after obtaining them the mystery can be completed. These are the final hotspots where the strange token can be found so obtain it and complete the A New Age mystery before moving on.

114-115

Return to the Kharid-et - Praetorium excavation site and excavate the praetorian remains. One of the staves is required if creating your own inquisitor staff. Pages for the commander's log and praetorian's log can be obtained here. You can complete the Hat Problem collection for the first time by handing in artefacts to the Wise Old Man.

115-116

Go to the Bandos's sanctum debris excavation spots at the Warforge - Bandos's sanctum excavation site.

116-117

Go to the Infernal Source - Dagon Overlook south-west excavation site and excavate Tsutsaroth remains. You can now complete the Zamorakian IV, Museum - Zamorakian IV, and Hat Hoarder collections.

117-118

Train at the optimatoi remains in the Everlight - Underwater cave excavation site. The Saradominist IV and Museum - Saradominist IV collections can be completed for the first time by handing in artefacts to Sir Atcha and Velucia.

118-119

First return to Stormguard Citadel - Howl's workshop excavation site and train at Howl's workshop debris. The Armadylean III, Museum - Armadylean III, and Magic Man collections can be completed for the first time.

After obtaining the artefacts from the workshop debris switch to war table debris at the Kharid-et - Praetorium excavation site. Complete the Zarosian IV, Museum - Zarosian IV, and Imperial Impressionism collections. This is the last hotspot where the six commander's log and five praetorian's log pages can be obtained, so get them and complete the Decimation and Shadow Fall mysteries if you have not already done so before continuing.

119-120

Start by going to the Orthen - Xolo city excavation site and obtaining the required artefacts from the Xolo remains.

Next go to the makeshift pie oven hotspots in the Warforge - Thalmund's forge excavation site. You can complete the Museum - Bandosian III collection, with Velucia; Green Gobbo Goodies III collection, with General Wartface; Red Rum Relics III collection, with General Bentnoze; and Knowledge is Power collection, with the Wise Old Man.

120+

Continue training at the Orthen - Xolo city excavation site. The saurthen debris is the highest level excavation site available. One of each artefact is required to complete the Mysterious City mystery. The final two artefact collections, Dragonkin IV and Museum - Dragonkin IV, can be completed by handing in artefacts to Sharrigan and Velucia. If you have not already completed I Am Become Death the four pages required to solve the mystery can be obtained here.

c.g: Money making using the Archaeology skill
c.h:
Players may obtain chronotes by handing in restored artefacts to collectors. All collectors offer chronotes for each artefact handed in, as well as a collection bonus.

Collections can be completed an infinite number of times and always reward the same amount of chronotes.

Velucia offers a slightly larger set bonus for completed collections.

c.g: Money making using the Archaeology skill
c.h:
Material caches are an effective way to make money, since they are geared specifically for harvesting materials. The experience given won't match that of excavation hotspots, because no artefacts can be found at caches. Caches in non-dig site areas do not yield any soil.

As many caches are located far from deposit boxes, players can use a Beast of Burden such as a war tortoise or pack yak to carry more items and reduce the number of bank trips. Players can also bring signs of the porter or the grace of the elves necklace to automatically transport materials to the material storage container.

c.g: Money making using the Archaeology skill
c.h:
Players can buy various types of soil on the Grand Exchange, and then screen them at the screening station in the Archaeology Campus for experience and materials. Rarely, damaged artefacts may be found while sifting soil. Some soil will not yield any rewards, although most of them generally do, though this is typically limited to more common materials.

There are six different types of soil not counting the Senntisten soil used during the tutorial. The minimum level is the level required to be able to screen that soil. The maximum level is the highest level of the material which can be obtained with that soil. With higher levels, players will get more valuable materials and experience with the same type of soil. The soil box can be used to screen more soil at one time, maximum capacity is 500 each with all soil box upgrades.

Using screening station

A fast method to screen soil is as follows:

  1. Only equip the archaeological soil box, keeping the rest of the backpack empty
  2. Visit the bank chest at the Archaeology Campus
  3. Select "Fill" option on the soil box to fill it with all the soil types from your bank; maximum capacity is 500 each with soil box upgrade
  4. Walk to the screening station and screen your soil until your backpack is full of materials
  5. Deposit all materials to material storage container after setting the default option to "Deposit-All"
  6. Repeat from step 2
Using Sift Soil
Required items:
  • Archaeological soil box
  • Mud battlestaff (or equivalent) and astral runes for Sift Soil spell
  • Master archaeologist's outfit
  • Optional items:
  • Dwarf weed incense sticks for chance to automatically bank material
  • Waterfiend familiar to provide a chance at gaining extra material or artefacts
  • Grace of the elves with charges

With a full soil box and required items, players can cast Sift Soil near any material storage container and deposit all materials. If using grace of the elves, dwarf weed incense sticks, players can expect roughly 5,680 materials per hour.
